_comment: Placeholder only - NOT a credential. compose mounts this file read-only at /run/secrets/google-drive-service-account.json when GOOGLE_DRIVE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_HOST_FILE is unset, so the bind source always exists. The API ignores it unless GOOGLE_DRIVE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE is also set, and rejects it with a clear error if it is. Never replace this file with a real key: point GOOGLE_DRIVE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_HOST_FILE at a key stored outside the repository.
